c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Viser kampanjen som ordren ble opprettet fra.
Shows the total product amount for the quote, minus any discounts. This value is added to freight and tax amounts in the calculation for the total amount due for the quote.
Viser det totale produktbeløpet for tilbudet, minus eventuelle rabatter. Denne verdien legges til i frakt- og avgiftsbeløp i beregningen for totalbeløpet som forfaller for tilbudet.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the total product amount for the quote, minus any discounts. This value is added to freight and tax amounts in the calculation for the total amount due for the quote.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Unik identifikator for representanten som endret oppføringen.
Type the second line of the customer's shipping address.
Skriv inn den andre linjen i kundens leveringsadresse.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the second line of the customer's shipping address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the quote number for customer reference and searching capabilities. The number cannot be modified.
Viser tilbudsnummeret for kundereferanse og søkefunksjoner. Nummeret kan ikke endres.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the quote number for customer reference and searching capabilities. The number cannot be modified.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the total of the Manual Discount amounts specified on all products included in the quote. This value is reflected in the Detail Amount field on the quote and is added to any discount amount or rate specified on the quote

Viser summen av de manuelle rabattbeløpene angitt på alle produkter inkludert i tilbudet. Denne verdien gjenspeiles i feltet Detaljbeløp i tilbudet og legges til i eventuelle rabattbeløp eller satser angitt i tilbudet

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the total of the Manual Discount amounts specified on all products included in the quote. This value is reflected in the Detail Amount field on the quote and is added to any discount amount or rate specified on the quote

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Value of the Invoice Setup Totals in base currency.
Verdien av summene for fakturaoppett i standardvaluta.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Value of the Invoice Setup Totals in base currency.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type a name for the customer's billing address, such as "Headquarters" or "Field office", to identify the address.
Skriv inn et navn for kundens faktureringsadresse, for eksempel Hovedkontor eller Eksternt kontor, for å identifisere adressen.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type a name for the customer's billing address, such as "Headquarters" or "Field office", to identify the address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the cost of freight or shipping for the products included in the quote for use in calculating the Total Amount field.
Skriv inn kostnaden for frakt eller levering for produktene inkludert i tilbudet, for bruk i beregning av feltet Totalbeløp.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the cost of freight or shipping for the products included in the quote for use in calculating the Total Amount field.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the freight terms to make sure shipping orders are processed correctly.
Velg leveringsbetingelsene for å sikre at ordreforsendelser beregnes riktig.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the freight terms to make sure shipping orders are processed correctly.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Freight terms for the shipping address.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Freight terms for the shipping address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the sum of all existing and write-in products included on the quote, based on the specified price list and quantities.
Viser summen av alle eksisterende produkter og produkter i produktkatalogen inkludert i tilbudet, basert på den angitte prislisten og antallene.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the sum of all existing and write-in products included on the quote, based on the specified price list and quantities.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Enter the date a decision or order is due from the customer to indicate the expiration date of the quote.
Angi datoen som en avgjørelse eller ordre forfaller fra kunden på, for å indikere utløpsdatoen for tilbudet.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Enter the date a decision or order is due from the customer to indicate the expiration date of the quote.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the date and time when the record was created. The date and time are displayed in the time zone selected in Microsoft Dynamics CRM options.
Dato og klokkeslett oppføringen ble opprettet.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the date and time when the record was created. The date and time are displayed in the time zone selected in Microsoft Dynamics CRM options.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Date and time that the record was migrated.
Dato og klokkeslett oppføringen ble overført.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Date and time that the record was migrated.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: The latest end date of all associated quote lines
Den siste sluttdatoen for alle tilknyttede tilbudslinjer

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: The latest end date of all associated quote lines

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.
Tidssonekode som var i bruk da oppføringen ble opprettet.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Unique identifier of the billing address.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Unique identifier of the billing address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the first line of the customer's billing address.
Skriv inn den første linjen i kundens faktureringsadresse.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the first line of the customer's billing address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the version number of the quote for revision history tracking.
Viser versjonsnummeret for tilbudet for sporing av revisjonshistorikk.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the version number of the quote for revision history tracking.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows whether the quote is draft, active, won, or closed. Only draft quotes can be edited.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows whether the quote is draft, active, won, or closed. Only draft quotes can be edited.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the total amount due, calculated as the sum of the products, discounts, freight, and taxes for the quote.
Viser totalbeløpet som forfaller, beregnet som summen av produktene, rabatter, frakt og avgifter for tilbudet.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the total amount due, calculated as the sum of the products, discounts, freight, and taxes for the quote.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Reason for the status of the quote.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Reason for the status of the quote.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the second line of the customer's billing address.
Skriv inn den andre linjen i kundens faktureringsadresse.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the second line of the customer's billing address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the city for the customer's shipping address.
Skriv inn poststedet for kundens leveringsadresse.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the city for the customer's shipping address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the ID of the process.
Inneholder IDen for prosessen som er knyttet til enheten.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the ID of the process.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Unik identifikator for valutaen som er tilknyttet enheten.
Unik identifikator for brukeren som endret oppføringen.
Shows the total of the Tax amounts specified on all products included in the quote, included in the Total Amount due calculation for the quote.
Viser summen av avgiftsbeløpene angitt på alle produkter inkludert i tilbudet, inkludert i beregningen av totalbeløp som forfaller for tilbudet.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the total of the Tax amounts specified on all products included in the quote, included in the Total Amount due calculation for the quote.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Unique identifier of the shipping address.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Unique identifier of the shipping address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the payment terms to indicate when the customer needs to pay the total amount.
Velg betalingsvilkårene for å angi når kunden må betale totalbeløpet.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the payment terms to indicate when the customer needs to pay the total amount.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Velg salgsmuligheten som tilbudet er relatert til, for rapportering og analyser.

Skriv inn en alternativ e-postadresse for kontakten.

Skriv inn telefonnummeret til kontaktens overordnede.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated. The date and time are displayed in the time zone selected in Microsoft Dynamics 365 options.
Viser datoen og klokkeslettet oppføringen sist ble oppdatert. Datoen og klokkeslettet vises i tidssonen som er valgt i alternativene for Microsoft Dynamics 365.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated. The date and time are displayed in the time zone selected in Microsoft Dynamics 365 options.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the phonetic spelling of the contact's last name, if the name is specified in Japanese, to make sure the name is pronounced correctly in phone calls with the contact.
Skriv inn den fonetiske skrivemåten av kontaktens etternavn, hvis navnet er angitt på japansk, for å sikre at navnet uttales riktig i telefonsamtaler med kontakten.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the phonetic spelling of the contact's last name, if the name is specified in Japanese, to make sure the name is pronounced correctly in phone calls with the contact.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the phonetic spelling of the contact's first name, if the name is specified in Japanese, to make sure the name is pronounced correctly in phone calls with the contact.
Skriv inn den fonetiske skrivemåten av kontaktens fornavn, hvis navnet er angitt på japansk, for å sikre at navnet uttales riktig i telefonsamtaler med kontakten.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the phonetic spelling of the contact's first name, if the name is specified in Japanese, to make sure the name is pronounced correctly in phone calls with the contact.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the longitude value for the primary address for use in mapping and other applications.
Skriv inn lengdegradsverdien for primæradressen for bruk i kart og andre programmer.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the longitude value for the primary address for use in mapping and other applications.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select whether the contact allows direct mail. If Do Not Allow is selected, the contact will be excluded from letter activities distributed in marketing campaigns.
Velg om kontakten tillater direktepost. Hvis det merkes av for Ikke tillat, utelates kontakten fra brevaktiviteter distribuert i markedsføringskampanjer.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select whether the contact allows direct mail. If Do Not Allow is selected, the contact will be excluded from letter activities distributed in marketing campaigns.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Information about whether to allow sending postal mail to the contact.
Informasjon som angir om det skal være tillatt å sende vanlig post til kontakten.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Information about whether to allow sending postal mail to the contact.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the combined Yomi first and last names of the contact so that the full phonetic name can be displayed in views and reports.
Viser kombinert Yomi-fornavn og -etternavn for kontakten slik at hele det fonetiske navnet kan vises i visninger og rapporter.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the combined Yomi first and last names of the contact so that the full phonetic name can be displayed in views and reports.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type of address for address 1, such as billing, shipping, or primary address.
Adressetype for adresse 1, for eksempel faktura-, leverings- eller primæradresse.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the county for the secondary address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select whether the contact is on a credit hold, for reference when addressing invoice and accounting issues.
Velg om det er angitt kredittstopp for kontakten, for referanse når du henvender deg om faktura- og regnskapsspørsmål.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select whether the contact is on a credit hold, for reference when addressing invoice and accounting issues.

Informasjon som angir om kreditt for kontakten er på vent.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the city for the secondary address.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the city for the secondary address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select whether the contact accepts bulk postal mail sent through marketing campaigns or quick campaigns. If Do Not Allow is selected, the contact can be added to marketing lists, but will be excluded from the letters.

Velg om kontakten godtar masseutsendelse av post via markedsføringskampanjer eller hurtigkampanjer. Hvis det merkes av for Ikke tillat, kan kontakten legges til i markedsføringslister, men utelates fra brev.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select whether the contact accepts bulk postal mail sent through marketing campaigns or quick campaigns. If Do Not Allow is selected, the contact can be added to marketing lists, but will be excluded from the letters.

Informasjon som angir om det skal være tillatt å sende store mengder vanlig post til kontakten.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Information about whether to allow sending bulk-rate postal mail to the contact.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the main phone number for this contact.
Skriv inn hovedtelefonnummeret for denne kontakten.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the main phone number for this contact.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the contact's gender to make sure the contact is addressed correctly in sales calls, email, and marketing campaigns.
Velg kontaktens kjønn for å sikre at du henvender deg til kontakten på riktig måte i salgssamtaler, e-post og markedsføringskampanjer.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the contact's gender to make sure the contact is addressed correctly in sales calls, email, and marketing campaigns.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the time zone, or UTC offset, for this address so that other people can reference it when they contact someone at this address.
Velg tidssonen, eller UTC-forskyvningen, for denne adressen slik at andre kan referere til den når de kontakter personer på denne adressen.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the time zone, or UTC offset, for this address so that other people can reference it when they contact someone at this address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the name of the main contact at the account's third address.
Skriv inn navnet på hovedkontakten på forretningsforbindelsens tredjeadresse.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the name of the main contact at the account's third address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select a shipping method for deliveries sent to this address.
Velg en leveringsmetode for leveringer som sendes til denne adressen.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select a shipping method for deliveries sent to this address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Unique identifier of the business unit that owns the contact.
Unik identifikator for forretningsenheten som eier kontakten.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Unique identifier of the business unit that owns the contact.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the preferred time of day for service appointments.
Velg den foretrukkede tiden på dagen for serviceavtaler.

Tidspunkt på dagen som kontakten foretrekker for planlegging av serviceaktiviteter.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Time of day that the contact prefers for scheduling service activities.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the state or province of the secondary address.
Skriv inn delstaten eller området for sekundæradressen.

Skriv inn den andre linjen i sekundæradressen.

Viser feltet Aldersfordelt 60 konvertert til systemets standardvaluta. Beregningene bruker valutakursen angitt i området Valutaer.

Viser hvem som sist oppdaterte oppføringen på vegne av en annen bruker.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows who last updated the record on behalf of another user.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Choose the service level agreement (SLA) that you want to apply to the Contact record.
Velg serviceavtalen (SLA) du vil bruke på kontaktoppføringen.

Skriv inn kredittgrensen for kontakten for referanse når du henvender deg til kunden om faktura- og regnskapsspørsmål.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the credit limit of the contact for reference when you address invoice and accounting issues with the customer.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Enter the contact's birthday for use in customer gift programs or other communications.
Angi kontaktens fødselsdag for bruk i kundegaveprogrammer eller annen kommunikasjon.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the time zone, or UTC offset, for this address so that other people can reference it when they contact someone at this address.
Velg tidssonen, eller UTC-forskyvningen, for denne adressen slik at andre kan referere til den når de kontakter personer på denne adressen.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the size of the contact's company for segmentation and reporting purposes.
Velg størrelsen på kontaktens selskap for segmenterings- og rapporteringsformål.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the Credit Limit field converted to the system's default base currency for reporting purposes. The calculations use the exchange rate specified in the Currencies area.

Velg om forretningsforbindelsen tillater masseutsendelse av post via markedsføringskampanjer eller hurtigkampanjer. Hvis det merkes av for Ikke tillat, kan forretningsforbindelsen legges til i markedsføringslister, men utelates fra post.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select whether the account allows bulk postal mail sent through marketing campaigns or quick campaigns. If Do Not Allow is selected, the account can be added to marketing lists, but will be excluded from the postal mail.

Informasjon som angir om det skal være tillatt å sende vanlig post til forretningsforbindelsen.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Information about whether to allow sending bulk-rate postal mail to the account.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.
Viser hvem som opprettet oppføringen på vegne av en annen bruker.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the main phone number for this account.
Skriv inn hovedtelefonnummeret for denne forretningsforbindelsen.

Skriv inn et annet telefonnummer for denne forretningsforbindelsen.

Velg en leveringsmetode for leveringer som sendes til denne adressen.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select a shipping method for deliveries sent to this address.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Value of the Travel Charge in base currency.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Viser emnet som forretningsforbindelsen ble opprettet fra, hvis forretningsforbindelsen ble opprettet ved å konvertere et emne i Microsoft Dynamics 365. Dette brukes for å relatere forretningsforbindelsen til data om det opprinnelige emnet for bruk i rapportering og analyser.
Select a category to indicate whether the customer account is standard or preferred.
Velg en kategori for å angi om kundekontoen er standard eller foretrukket.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select a category to indicate whether the customer account is standard or preferred.

Rullegardinliste for valg av kategori for forretningsforbindelsen.

Skriv inn delstaten eller området for sekundæradressen.

Skriv inn den andre linjen i sekundæradressen.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the freight terms for the primary address to make sure shipping orders are processed correctly.
Velg leveringsbetingelsene for primæradressen for å sikre at ordreforsendelser behandles riktig.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the freight terms for the primary address to make sure shipping orders are processed correctly.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the credit limit of the account. This is a useful reference when you address invoice and accounting issues with the customer.
Skriv inn kredittgrensen for forretningsforbindelsen. Dette er en nyttig referanse når du henvender deg til kunden om faktura- og regnskapsspørsmål.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the credit limit of the account. This is a useful reference when you address invoice and accounting issues with the customer.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Sum of open revenue against an account and its child accounts.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Sum of open revenue against an account and its child accounts.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the time zone, or UTC offset, for this address so that other people can reference it when they contact someone at this address.
Velg tidssonen, eller UTC-forskyvningen, for denne adressen slik at andre kan referere til den når de kontakter personer på denne adressen.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the time zone, or UTC offset, for this address so that other people can reference it when they contact someone at this address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Choose the parent account associated with this account to show parent and child businesses in reporting and analytics.
Velg den overordnede forretningsforbindelsen som er tilknyttet denne forretningsforbindelsen, for å vise overordnede og underordnede virksomheter i rapportering og analyser.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Choose the parent account associated with this account to show parent and child businesses in reporting and analytics.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the preferred time of day for service appointments.
Velg den foretrukkede tiden på dagen for serviceavtaler.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the preferred time of day for service appointments.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Time of day that the account prefers for scheduling service activities.
Tidspunkt på dagen som forretningsforbindelsen foretrekker for planlegging av serviceaktiviteter.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Time of day that the account prefers for scheduling service activities.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the number of employees that work at the account for use in marketing segmentation and demographic analysis.
Skriv inn antall ansatte som arbeider hos forretningsforbindelsen, for bruk i markedsføringssegmentering og demografisk analyse.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the number of employees that work at the account for use in marketing segmentation and demographic analysis.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the main phone number associated with the primary address.
Skriv inn hovedtelefonnummeret som er knyttet til primæradressen.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the main phone number associated with the primary address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select a classification code to indicate the potential value of the customer account based on the projected return on investment, cooperation level, sales cycle length or other criteria.
Velg en klassifiseringskode for å angi den potensielle verdien for en kundekonto basert på beregnet kapitalavkastning, samarbeidsnivå, salgssykluslengde eller andre vilkår.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select a classification code to indicate the potential value of the customer account based on the projected return on investment, cooperation level, sales cycle length or other criteria.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Drop-down list for classifying an account.
Rullegardinliste for klassifisering av en forretningsforbindelse.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Drop-down list for classifying an account.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the size category or range of the account for segmentation and reporting purposes.
Velg størrelseskategorien eller -området for forretningsforbindelsen for segmenterings- og rapporteringsformål.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select the size category or range of the account for segmentation and reporting purposes.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the credit limit converted to the system's default base currency for reporting purposes.
Viser kredittgrensen konvertert til systemets standardvaluta, for rapporteringsformål.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the credit limit converted to the system's default base currency for reporting purposes.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the conversion rate of the record's currency. The exchange rate is used to convert all money fields in the record from the local currency to the system's default currency.
Viser konverteringsforholdet for oppføringsvalutaen. Valutakursen brukes for å konvertere alle pengefelt i oppføringen fra den lokale valutaen til systemets standardvaluta.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the conversion rate of the record's currency. The exchange rate is used to convert all money fields in the record from the local currency to the system's default currency.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the county for the secondary address.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the county for the secondary address.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: The Service Territory this account belongs to. This is used to optimize scheduling and routing
Servicedistriktet denne forretningsforbindelsen tilhører. Dette brukes til å optimalisere planlegging og ruting

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: The Service Territory this account belongs to. This is used to optimize scheduling and routing

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Choose the primary contact for the account to provide quick access to contact details.
Velg den primære kontakten for forretningsforbindelsen for å gi rask tilgang til kontaktdetaljer.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Choose the primary contact for the account to provide quick access to contact details.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type a third phone number for this account.
Skriv inn et tredje telefonnummer for denne forretningsforbindelsen.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the government tax exempt number.

Skriv inn breddegradsverdien for sekundæradressen for bruk i kart og andre programmer.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Type the latitude value for the secondary address for use in mapping and other applications.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the date and time when the record was created. The date and time are displayed in the time zone selected in Microsoft Dynamics 365 options.
Viser opprettingsdato og -klokkeslett for oppføringen. Datoen og klokkeslettet vises i tidssonen som velges i alternativene for Microsoft Dynamics 365.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Shows the date and time when the record was created. The date and time are displayed in the time zone selected in Microsoft Dynamics 365 options.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select whether the account allows bulk email sent through campaigns. If Do Not Allow is selected, the account can be added to marketing lists, but is excluded from email.

Velg om forretningsforbindelsen tillater masseutsendelse av e-post via kampanjer. Hvis det merkes av for Ikke tillat, kan forretningsforbindelsen legges til i markedsføringslister, men utelates fra e-post.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select whether the account allows bulk email sent through campaigns. If Do Not Allow is selected, the account can be added to marketing lists, but is excluded from email.

Informasjon som angir om det er tillatt å sende direkte e-post til forretningsforbindelsen.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Information about whether to allow sending direct email to the account.

c:LocalizedLabel.c:Label: Select whether the account allows faxes. If Do Not Allow is selected, the account will be excluded from fax activities distributed in marketing campaigns.
Velg om forretningsforbindelsen tillater telefakser. Hvis det merkes av for Ikke tillat, utelates forretningsforbindelsen fra telefaksaktiviteter distribuert i markedsføringskampanjer.

Total tid som er brukt på e-post (lesing og skriving) og møter av meg i forhold til en forretningsforbindelsesoppføring.

c:UserLocalizedLabel.c:Label: Total time spent for emails (read and write) and meetings by me in relation to account record.
